sections.normalized_html:
We are told that [MATH: 90] is [MATH: k\%] greater than [MATH: 20,] so the total increase is

[MATH: 20 + \dfrac{k}{100} \cdot 20.]

That gives us the equation:

[MATH: 20 + \dfrac{k}{100} \cdot 20 = 90]

Now, we solve for [MATH: k{:}]

[MATH: 20 + (k)/(100) ⋅ 20|= 90; (k)/(100) ⋅ 20|= 90 − 20; (k)/(100) ⋅ 20|= 70; (k)/(100)|= (70)/(20); (k)/(100)|= 3.5; k|= 350]

So, the value of [MATH: k] is [MATH: 350.]
